wish: someone should make a game where the enemies are neural networks that get better at fighting you over time
spec:
Five red enemies, each steered by a small neural network, hunt you in a top-down arena.
Tap or drag in the arena to run; when a round ends, the enemy population is evolved against the path you just ran.
No network, no pretrained data: the learning is a quick evolutionary search on your device, and it is single-player only.
